findings.title: Beaconing to image.weather.com from 192.168.15.4
findings.description: 7 events to image.weather.com with mean interval 899.5s (stddev 1.40s, CoV 0.002) — the cadence is too regular to be human browsing.
reasoning_chain: Coefficient of variation 0.002 is below threshold 0.15.
Uniform cadence is consistent with automated/beaconing traffic.
Cadence alone cannot distinguish a benign timer (e.g. a weather widget) from C2; confidence capped at Medium (0.70) pending corroborating signals (SFE-fqn).
